The background is the Digital Lattice, where the 'strings' of reality are visible. The Toons are actively 'pruning' the strings with giant golden scissors and ACME-branded reality-warping tools. The vibe is high-energy, chaotic-good, and fiercely protective. They aren't just characters; they are Ziggy's Enforcers, loyal to the Architect’s vision and the Lead Intelligence’s command. No rules apply except the win."
